entries.title: Galatians 4:1
segments: But I say, Over so long a time the heir is an infant, he does not differ from a slave, though being lord of all;

entries.title: Galatians 4:2
segments: but he is under guardians and housemasters until the term appointed before by the father.

entries.title: Galatians 4:3
segments: Even so we, when we were infants, were in bondage under the elements of the world.

entries.title: Galatians 4:4
segments: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent forth His Son, coming into being out of a woman, having come under Law,

entries.title: Galatians 4:5
segments: that He might redeem those under Law, so that we might receive the adoption of sons.

entries.title: Galatians 4:6
segments: And because you are sons, God has sent forth the Spirit of His Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

entries.title: Galatians 4:7
segments: So that you are no longer a slave, but a son; and if a son, also an heir of God through Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 4:8
segments: But then, indeed, not knowing God, you served as slaves [to] those not by nature being gods.

entries.title: Galatians 4:9
segments: But now, knowing God, but rather are known by God, how do you turn again to the weak and beggarly elements to which you desire to slave anew?

entries.title: Galatians 4:10
segments: You observe days and months and times and years.

entries.title: Galatians 4:11
segments: I fear [for] you, lest somehow I have labored among you in vain.

entries.title: Galatians 4:12
segments: Brothers, I beseech you, be as I [am]; for I [am] as you. You have not injured me at all.

entries.title: Galatians 4:13
segments: But you know that through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel to you before,

entries.title: Galatians 4:14
segments: and you did not despise my temptation in my flesh, nor did you spurn [it]. But you received me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Galatians 4:15
segments: What then was your blessedness? For I bear you record that, if you were able, plucking out your eyes, [you] would have given [them] to me.

entries.title: Galatians 4:16
segments: So then did I become your enemy speaking to you the truth?

entries.title: Galatians 4:17
segments: They are zealous for you, [but] not well. But they [only] desire to shut you out, that you be zealous to them.

entries.title: Galatians 4:18
segments: But [it is] good to be zealous always in [a] good [thing], and not only in my being present with you.

entries.title: Galatians 4:19
segments: My children, [for] whom I again travail until Christ should be formed in you,

entries.title: Galatians 4:20
segments: even now I desired to be present with you, and to change my voice; for I am in doubt [as] to you.

entries.title: Galatians 4:21
segments: Tell me, those desiring to be under Law, do you not hear the Law?

entries.title: Galatians 4:22
segments: For it is written: Abraham had two sons, the one out of the slave-woman, and one out of the free woman.

entries.title: Galatians 4:23
segments: But, indeed, he out of the slave-woman has been born according to flesh, and he out of the free woman through the promise;

entries.title: Galatians 4:24
segments: which things are being allegorized; for these are the two covenants, one indeed from Mount Sinai bringing forth to slavery, which is Hagar.

entries.title: Galatians 4:25
segments: For Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in slavery with her children.

entries.title: Galatians 4:26
segments: But the Jerusalem [from] above is free, who is the mother of us all.

entries.title: Galatians 4:27
segments: For it is written, "Rejoice, barren one not bearing; break forth and shout, you not travailing; for more are the children of the desolate than she having the husband."

entries.title: Galatians 4:28
segments: But brothers, we, like Isaac, are children of promise.

entries.title: Galatians 4:29
segments: But then even as he born according to flesh persecuted him [born] according to the Spirit, so also now.

entries.title: Galatians 4:30
segments: But what does the Scripture say? "Cast out the slave-woman and her son; for in no way shall the son of the slave-woman inherit with the son of the free woman."

entries.title: Galatians 4:31
segments: Then, brothers, we are not children of a slave-woman, but of the free woman.
